evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: First, we curate existing suites for discriminability and efficiency, producing Meta-Video, a balanced 1,000-question benchmark over 791 videos spanning diverse tasks and durations, which largely preserves model rankings, at 5 times inference speedup for a full-frame count sweep experiment (4-128 frames).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Even for the same model checkpoint, evaluation configuration alone can shift accuracy by up to 19.5pp.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Second, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol by sweeping the configuration space to isolate choices that measurably affect results, distill them into best practices and reporting standards, and release reproducible reference scores across five models and seven benchmarks.
